description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of matched and not matched instances for different categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “No Hallucination”, “Oriented”, “Active”, “Rigorous”, “Correct”, and a category labeled with a gray bar and no explicit name, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents percentage, labeled as such, with a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, and tick labels at 20% intervals. Each category is represented by two horizontally oriented bars: a blue bar labeled “Matched” and a light blue bar labeled “Not Matched”. For “No Hallucination”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 98.33% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 1.67%. For “Oriented”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 97.33% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 2.67%. For “Active”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 97.00% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 3.00%. The unnamed category has a “Matched” bar extending to approximately 94.00% and a “Not Matched” bar extending to approximately 6.00%. For “Rigorous”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 95.33% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 4.67%. Finally, for “Correct”, the “Matched” bar extends to approximately 99.00% and the “Not Matched” bar extends to approximately 1.00%. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each category, visually representing the proportion of matched versus not matched instances. The bar representing the unnamed category is visually distinguished by being gray instead of blue.
